subject: Sequential capacity gating and supplier interop for Aurora Analytics onramp
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: NVIDIA Sales <nvidia-sales@partners.nvidia.com>, CloudPartnerOps <ops@cloudvendor.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Kickoff: sequential capacity gating + supplier interop for Aurora onramp

Hi team,

Thanks for looping in. Aurora Analytics (DEAL-9743) has committed to a stepped onramp: +40% capacity in Q1, +60% by Q2, full steady-state by Q3. Their SRE window for cutover is tight (target week of 2027-02-20). We need a clear plan that combines OEM deliveries (NVIDIA SKUs), cloud partner reserve lanes, and a set of gating checks so we only pull inventory forward when Aurora completes key milestones.

Initial asks: 
- NVIDIA: can you provide a 90/60/30-day quote and firm ETA windows by SKU (including a soft commit for alternate SKUs if primary SKUs slip)? Prefer separate lines for 8x A40-like and 4x H100-like equivalents. Attachment: vendor quote preferred.
- CloudPartnerOps: confirm how fast we can lift a short-term reserved pool (48–72h lead) and any cost delta for a 3-month bridge.
- Internal (Karthik/Ben/Marissa): please map the deal gating milestones (MVP, perf test sign-off, legal/PO) to procurement triggers so we can codify a release cadence.

I'll coordinate a weekly 30-min sync for the next six weeks; propose Tuesdays 10am PT.

Thanks,
Jonas
--
Jonas Weber
Head of Strategic Supply

Date: 2026-11-16T10:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: sequential capacity gating + supplier interop for Aurora onramp

Jonas —

Appreciate the clear ask. Attached is a preliminary quote (NVIDIA-Quote-Aurora-20261116.pdf) with three leadtime bands: standard (12–16 wks), expedited (6–8 wks), and contingency (4–6 wks via bonded channel). Note: expedited availability depends on global queue at time of booking; we can provide a soft hold for 21 days once PO is submitted.

Key callouts:
- SKU parity: we can offer H100-equivalent and Hopper-LT variants; the performance delta is ~6–12% depending on frame sizes.
- Alternate SKUs: will appear as optional lines on the quote. If you select alternates we can include a swap clause that allows substitution within the 21-day soft hold.
- Logistics: international shipments may hit customs variance; bonded inventory option removes customs risk but adds 1–2% uplift.

We can join the Tuesday 10am PT sync. Happy to walk through the quote and the swap clause.

Onwards,
Alex Park
Strategic Accounts, NVIDIA
Attachments: NVIDIA-Quote-Aurora-20261116.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)

Quick internal note:

Thanks Alex — the 21-day soft hold is useful. From the product/ops side we want two explicit procurement triggers:

1) Gate A (MVP completion): release 40% of first tranche (standard ETA) — acceptable to use alternate SKUs if latency impact <8%.
2) Gate B (Perf sign-off + PO): convert soft hold to firm order and release expedited tranche for +20% capacity.
3) Gate C (Go-live prep): invoke bonded contingency for last-mile if customs or OEM backlog threatens the Q3 steady-state date.

Two additional asks for vendor interop:
- CloudPartnerOps: confirm API for provisioning reserve capacity (we need an automated signal to flip the bridge pool on without manual ticketing).
- Finance: need the confirmed uplift % for bonded vs standard shipments so we can bake into the deal economics.

I'll draft the procurement trigger matrix and share by EOD Thursday.

— Karthik

Subject: Aurora onramp: proposed gating calendar and ask on PO timing

Hi Dana / procurement team —

Thanks again for the momentum on your side. To align expectations we propose the following high-level gating calendar: 

- Dec 15, 2026: MVP acceptance (Gate A) — triggers initial reservation release and test capacity slot.
- Jan 20, 2027: Performance sign-off (Gate B) — we convert soft holds to firm orders for the second tranche.
- Feb 18, 2027: Cutover rehearsal window (pre-Go-live) — final bonded contingency decision by Feb 10 if customs or ETA risk persists.

Action requested: please confirm by Dec 1 whether Aurora will issue a PO that converts the 21-day soft hold into a firm 30-day PO window for Gate B. If you need a two-step PO (initial deposit + final), note it in your reply and we'll adjust the release cadence.
